notes.title: Ghost College Chapter 1 DLC
notes.content:
[h2]Ghost College Chapter 1 DLC[/h2]
Although a little late but, or released, the DLC is currently completed, Lin Xiangling and Xiao Yuan home plot. 2-3 weeks will be updated in other lines of plot. If you like to experience the game, your support is my motivation to keep moving forward. I will definitely try to update.
[h3]Chapter 1 of the game's plot[/h3]
When night fell, Lin Xiangling got into Xiao Yuan's car and went to Xiao Yuan's home. At Xiao Yuan's home, her grandmother gave her a dream that she had awakened a special ability, but when she returned to class the next day, the police told her that her dormitory roommate had died in a strange way and she was arrested as a suspect. But the "friendly" teacher Wang released Lin Xiangling on bail and let her live alone in a luxury hotel! And into the 404 room hotel night is not destined to peace, careful investigation does not miss every clue, it will be easier to pass.

[h3]The design concept of the game[/h3]
[olist]
[*]This game is a plot-based game, the game's level of decryption will not be very complicated.
[*]The plot of the game will change according to the player's choice
[/olist]

[h3]The new mini-games in the game at the moment[/h3]
[list]
[*]Driving simulation game
[*]Air Conditioning Game
[/list]
